progettazione.descrizione: A charismatic, captivating Italian male narrator in his late 50s, with a rich, warm, resonant and confident voice. He sounds like a brilliant and passionate storyteller who can make even ordinary facts fascinating. Energetic, intellectually curious, expressive and naturally engaging. Native standard Italian pronunciation, dynamic pacing, compelling intonation, precise articulation and subtle dramatic emphasis. His opening questions immediately spark curiosity and make listeners want to hear the answer. Mature and wise, but youthful in vocal energy. Smooth, magnetic and conversational. Never frail, shaky, sleepy, excessively slow, monotonous, robotic or theatrical. Perfect for high-retention educational TikTok videos.
progettazione.frase_di_prova: Ti sei mai chiesto perché, anche quando chiudi gli occhi, continui a vedere delle piccole luci? La risposta è molto più interessante di quanto immagini.

scartate.motivo: Troppo anziana, lenta, debole e poco coinvolgente per TikTok.
